name: sulde
description: Sulde is a task orchestration and engineering delivery framework for AI agents: task definition and assignment, execution supervision, engineering checks, result verification, acceptance and rework, supported by knowledge retrieval and cross-session memory. Compatible tools can reuse MCP/CLI capabilities. Claude Code and Codex adapters are included; full supervision requires host adaptation and validation. Independently developed; source available under PolyForm Noncommercial 1.0.0; commercial use is not granted.
